notes: DRAFT for Ethereum mainnet (chain 1); not submitted. TODO before import: TODO_START = the unix time anyone may seed (the owner may seed earlier); $owner to be chosen (a fresh wallet; the owner cannot play seasons). The code is Sepolia test run 3's. The factory deploys PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one transaction: 11.6M gas measured as the chain charges it, 14.1M with a 22% gas-limit headroom, under Ethereum's 16,777,216 per-transaction cap (test/LaunchManifest.t.sol asserts it). Constructor arguments: PLEA(owner = $owner). CabalGate(PLEA, Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, oracle fee asset = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, pool IMD (same), oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, season 1296000 s = 15 days, dead-man 118800 s). Seasons(PLEA, CabalGate, IMD). PleaDistributor(PLEA, owner = $owner). PleaLaunch(PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, IMD, imd/acc's mainnet Stacker 0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0 (launch #1409), credit gas 400000, START, the Letterbox's oracle fee asset = IMD, mintOracleFee = false (the Letterbox buys the 0.5 IMD oracle fee with the writer's PLEA together with the tip), and the keccak256 of the Letterbox's creation code). After the launch, anyone calls PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox(creationCode) once (about 4.8M gas, its own transaction), then PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) with a salt mined off chain; PLEA.init mints 87% to the hook, 3% to Seasons and 10% to PleaDistributor; seed() opens trading (owner any time, anyone from START).
